items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: My heroes were Larry Shields and Rapolo.

ctx.x: Oh, so? It was a southern Indiana type of a combination of ragtime and tricky, funny music.

Now, if you realize that the Friars Inn band itself was a combination fundamentally, and don't pin me down too accurately on this, but I think it was an eight-piece band. It was fundamentally two four-piece bands. It was Mayers, of course, and George Brunas, and later on Leon Rapolo from New Orleans, white musicians from New Orleans, and Steve Brown, the bass. But fundamentally, or Deacon Loycano, rather, from New Orleans was the original bass player. But fundamentally, if you realize that the Snyder Brothers…
